# Vendor Onboarding FAQ

## How long does vendor onboarding take?

Standard vendor onboarding takes 10 business days once the security questionnaire and W-9 or equivalent tax form are received.

## Who approves new vendors?

Procurement approves vendors under 50,000 USD per year. Contracts above 50,000 USD per year also need sign-off from the finance director.
